beautyProducts.name: Sunlit Vanilla Eau de Parfum
beautyProducts.description:
Fragrance Family: Warm & Spicy

Scent Type: Warm & Sweet Gourmands

Key Notes: Bergamot, Caramel, Vanilla

Fragrance Description: A scent that captures the indulgence of dessert in the summer sun—cool vanilla ice cream and the delicate veil of a lightly caramelized crème brûlée. Warm notes of caramel melt into sweet vanilla, comforting tonka bean, and a soft touch of amber. This scent is cozy yet radiant and lingers on your skin like sunshine.
beautyProducts.productDescription:
Fragrance Family: Warm & Spicy

Scent Type: Warm & Sweet Gourmands

Key Notes: Bergamot, Caramel, Vanilla

Fragrance Description: A scent that captures the indulgence of dessert in the summer sun—cool vanilla ice cream and the delicate veil of a lightly caramelized crème brûlée. Warm notes of caramel melt into sweet vanilla, comforting tonka bean, and a soft touch of amber. This scent is cozy yet radiant and lingers on your skin like sunshine.
beautyProducts.applicationDirections:
Suggested Usage:
-Fragrance is intensified by the warmth of your own body. Apply in the creases of your knees and elbows for a longer-lasting, stronger scent.
-After applying, avoid rubbing or dabbing skin. This breaks down the fragrance, causing it to wear off more quickly.
-If you prefer placing fragrance on your wrists, be sure to reapply after frequent hand-washing, as this tends to rinse off the scent.
-Replace fragrance after 12 months. Expired perfumes more than a year old lose the integrity of the original scent.

Eau de Toilette or Eau de Parfum?:
The difference lies in the volume of perfume oil. While EDT contains five to nine percent, EDP contains more, usually eight to 14 percent. EDPs, therefore, last longer and smell more intense.

beautyProducts.description: TheraBreath Anticavity Fluoride Mouthwash in Sparkle Mint is an alcohol-free fluoride mouthwash designed to help prevent cavities, strengthen teeth and enamel, remineralize weakened enamel, help reverse early tooth decay, and freshen breath. Formulated with sodium fluoride, it provides 24-hour cavity protection when used as directed and delivers a refreshing Sparkle Mint flavor without the harsh burn of alcohol-based rinses. It is also vegan, gluten-free, kosher, and free from artificial colors, dyes, and saccharin.

beautyProducts.applicationDirections: For the 16 oz and 3 oz TheraBreath Anticavity Oral Rinse – Sparkle Mint, adults and children 18 years and older should use 10 mL once daily after brushing with toothpaste. Add during the rinse cycle. Standard washers: use 2 capfuls filled to Line 1. HE washers: use 2 capfuls filled to Line 2. Add to the fabric softener compartment or directly to the rinse cycle and allow a 16-minute rinse cycle.

homeItems.name: Lysol Disinfecting Wipes
homeItems.direction:
To sanitize: Pre-clean the surface, then use enough fresh wipes to thoroughly wet it. Keep the surface visibly wet for 10 seconds.

To disinfect: Pre-clean the surface, then use enough fresh wipes to thoroughly wet it. Keep the surface visibly wet for 4 minutes.

For general cleaning or allergen removal, wipe the surface with a fresh wipe and repeat for stubborn stains. Food-contact surfaces should be rinsed thoroughly with water after use.
